meta.name: mcp-builder
meta.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server building principles. Tool design, resource patterns, best practices.

copy.tagline: 构建符合 MCP 协议的服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在搭建 MCP 服务器，需要工具设计与资源模式指导
copy.tagline_en: Build MCP servers with correct tool and resource design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an MCP server and need guidance on tool and resource design.

howto.what: Claude 会按照 MCP 服务器构建规范来设计工具、资源和提示模板：强调单一职责、输入校验、结构化输出，并处理错误与安全配置。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建或调整 MCP 服务器、设计其中的工具或资源，或配置 Claude Desktop 的 MCP 连接时。

say.text: 帮我写一个 MCP 工具，输入城市名返回天气，包含参数说明。
say.note: Claude 会按工具设计原则给出 schema 和实现。

say.text: 我要给 MCP 服务器添加一个读取用户信息的资源，URI 用参数化模板。
say.note: 它会按资源模式生成动态资源代码。

say.text: 如何配置 Claude Desktop 连接我的 MCP 服务器？

howto.what_en: Claude follows MCP server building principles to design tools, resources, and prompts, emphasizing single-purpose tools, input validation, structured output, error handling, and security.
howto.when_en: When you ask to build or modify an MCP server, design its tools or resources, or configure Claude Desktop's MCP connection.

say_en.text: Create an MCP tool that returns weather for a city, with parameter descriptions.
say_en.note: Claude will apply tool design principles to generate schema and code.

say_en.text: Add a parameterized resource to my MCP server for reading user info.
say_en.note: It will follow resource patterns for dynamic URIs.

say_en.text: How do I configure Claude Desktop to connect to my MCP server?
say_en.note: Claude explains the command, args, and env fields.
